_doc: Known-and-accepted i18n exceptions for scripts/qa-i18n-check.mjs (BLOCKING CI gate). globalLiterals: strings exempt in every file (brand names, third-party product names). fileLiterals: per-file exact strings — keyed by string, not line, so entries survive code moving. identicalToEn: message keys whose uz/ru value is legitimately the same as en; supports * as a path-segment wildcard. Every entry needs a reason. Prune entries that stop appearing. Seeded 2026-08-24 from the tree at that date; entries marked DEBT are real gaps someone accepted, not exemptions.

globalLiterals.Talim AI: brand wordmark — identical in uz/en/ru by design (matches messages landing.footer.brand)
globalLiterals.Talim: short brand wordmark used in the marketing navbar/footer lockup
globalLiterals.Desmos: third-party product name in the graphing-calculator attribution link; the surrounding sentence IS translated (content.desmosAttribution)

apps/web/app/[locale]/(learner)/learner/.Video: DEBT — material-type badge in the MATERIAL_STYLES lookup table; keys content.aiVideo / tenant.filterVideo already exist and this should move onto them
apps/web/app/[locale]/(learner)/learner/.Slides: DEBT — same MATERIAL_STYLES table; belongs on a content.typeSlide key

identicalToEn.common.proPlan: plan name — 'Pro' is the product's own label in every locale
identicalToEn.auth.email: 'Email' is the borrowed form used in Uzbek and Russian UI
identicalToEn.locales.uz: language picker shows each language as its own endonym
identicalToEn.locales.en: language picker shows each language as its own endonym
identicalToEn.tenant.settings.slug: 'URL slug' is the technical term; kept untranslated so tutors can match it to the address bar
identicalToEn.tenant.students.importPlaceholder: sample CSV — the header row must be the literal column names the parser accepts (name,email,username)
identicalToEn.landing.tutors.cards.*.value: short acronyms/figures on the marketing stat cards
identicalToEn.landing.testimonials.items.*.name: person names
identicalToEn.landing.testimonials.items.*.initials: avatar initials derived from person names
identicalToEn.landing.footer.copyright: brand wordmark inside the copyright line
